newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hariri stake in Solidere unchanged - sources.
newsitem.headline: Hariri stake in Solidere unchanged - sources.

text.p: Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri has not reduced his holding in Solidere, the real estate company rebuilding central Beirut, sources close to him said on Thursday.
The Beirut daily ad-Diyar reported last week that Hariri, a billionaire construction tycoon, had reduced his stake to $90 million from $125 million.
Asked about the report, a source close to Hariri told Reuters: "Oh no, I think Hariri has forgotten about those $125 million."
A source close to Solidere also told Reuters that Hariri's stake in the company was still $125 million or 6.03 percent of its shares.
Solidere is Lebanon's biggest company and the flagship of Hariri's multi-billion dollars drive for Lebanon's post-war reconstruction.
